SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Enfermeira, trouxe um pouco de água pra você.

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ ありがとうございます!

SCRIPT.KOREAN: 어? 유만 씨, 제가 물을 다 마셔버려서 어떡하죠?
SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Oh no, Yuman—I drank all the water. What now?
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 嗯？宥万先生，我把水都喝光了怎么办啊？
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 咦？宥萬先生，我把水都喝光了，怎麼辦？
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あれ ユマンさん 私が全部飲んじゃいましたけどどうしましょう?
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Aduh, Yuman—aku abisin semua airnya. Gimana dong?
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Senhor Yuman... acho que acabei bebendo toda a água, desculpe.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Señor Yumán... creo que me terminé toda el agua, lo siento.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: اوه نه، یومان- من تمام آب را خوردم. حالا چی؟

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Come on~ It’s just water, I can buy more!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: え〜 水なんてまた買えばいいですよ!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Yah~ itu cuma air, aku bisa beli lagi kok!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Depois eu compro mais, não tem problema.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Luego puedo comprar más, no pasa nada.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: بیا ~ فقط آب است، می توانم بیشتر بخرم!

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: Next time, I’ll get you something cold!
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 今度 冷たいの買ってきますね!
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Lain kali, aku bawain yang dingin deh buat kamu!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Da próxima vez eu te trago uma bebida refrescante.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: La próxima vez le compraré una bebiba refrescante.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: دفعه بعد یه چیز سرد برات میارم!

SCRIPT.JAPANESE: 冷たいのって何ですか?

SCRIPT.ENGLISH: I mean... after you’re fully recovered!
SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 啊，当然要等您完全康复啦
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 啊，當然是等我完全康復之後
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: あ もちろん全部治ってから
SCRIPT.INDONESIAN: Maksudnya... setelah kamu bener-bener sembuh ya!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Bom, claro, quando você já estiver recuperado...
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Bueno, claro, cuando ya esté recuperado…
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: منظورم این است که بعد از بهبودی کامل!

SCRIPT.CHINESE_SIMPLIFIED: 到时候，到时候我再请您！
SCRIPT.CHINESE_TRADITIONAL: 那時候、那時候我再請你！
SCRIPT.JAPANESE: その時にご馳走します!
SCRIPT.PORTUGUESE: Quando melhorar, eu te convido pra beber.
SCRIPT.SPANISH: Cuando se recupere, lo invito a beber.
SCRIPT.PERSIAN: سپس من شما را درمان می کنم!
